bibl.title: Two Statue Fragments of a "snty" from Thebes.
bibl.seg: Mohamed Gamal Rashed, Two Statue Fragments of a "snty" from Thebes.
bibl.note: Two fragments [Cair. Inv. CK 1185; S.R. 8v.239] from the Karnak cachette. They probably belong to two different statues dated to the early Ptolemaic period. The larger fragment bears the first attestation in Thebes of the title of snty (Greek διοικητής).
